category: Hub operations for university innovation centres
oneLiner: KiLN keeps a university innovation hub's cohorts, ventures, milestones, money and grants in one system of record, and produces the donor reporting hubs assemble by hand.
definition: KiLN is an operating system for an innovation hub attached to a university or TVET centre. It holds cohorts, ventures, milestones with evidence, a double-entry ledger, grants and staff roles in one database, and generates the impact report a donor will accept.
audience: University innovation hubs, incubators and TVET centres that run cohorts, hold grants and report to donors: programme managers, finance officers, grant managers and directors.
markets: Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA)

features.name: Cohorts
features.detail: Programme type, capacity, start and end dates across incubator, accelerator, pre-incubation, bootcamp, short course and hackathon runs.

features.name: Ventures
features.detail: An application trail and six statuses from applied to closed, with founder contact and cohort attached.

features.name: Milestones
features.detail: Prototype, MVP, first revenue, incorporation, IP filing, investor introduction and graduation, each with evidence, a verifier and a verified date.

features.name: Ledger
features.detail: Double-entry finance with fourteen categories and a grant reference on every line, so a donor can be shown exactly where their money went.

features.name: Grants
features.detail: Award, tranche and reporting dates held against the venture and the ledger, not in a separate spreadsheet.

features.name: Roles
features.detail: Seven staff roles, from admin to donor-viewer, so a donor sees the report and not the payroll.

features.name: Reports
features.detail: Impact and financial reports generated from the same record the hub works in, as PDF.

features.name: Offline
features.detail: KiLN Cloud keeps working when the connection drops and syncs on return. KiLN Node runs entirely on the campus LAN.

outcomes: One record for cohorts, ventures, milestones, money and grants
Donor reports produced from live data instead of assembled by hand
Grant money traceable from award to receipt line
A hub that keeps its memory when the person who kept the spreadsheet leaves

pricing.covers: One hub, one programme, up to 20 ventures, impact dashboard, PDF reports, community portal
One hub, unlimited programmes and cohorts, finance and grant management, donor reporting, mentors, events
Multi-faculty or multi-campus, API access, white-label, single sign-on, dedicated onboarding
Migration from spreadsheets and WhatsApp, staff training, dashboard configuration

delivery.detail: Licence key and URL. Per-hub database on Cloudflare, browser client with offline cache and sync.
Appliance image for a campus mini-PC: Ubuntu, the KiLN services, optional Cloudflare Tunnel. The university owns and can air-gap it.

faqs.question: What is KiLN?
faqs.answer: An operating system for a university innovation hub: cohorts, ventures, milestones, a double-entry ledger, grants and donor reporting in one place.

faqs.question: How much does KiLN cost?
faqs.answer: KiLN Starter is $99 a month for one hub and one programme; Growth is $299; Institutional is $799 for multi-campus deployments. Implementation is a one-off $1,500 to $3,000.

faqs.question: Can it run without the internet?
faqs.answer: Yes. KiLN Node is an appliance that runs on the campus LAN and can be air-gapped. KiLN Cloud works offline in the browser and syncs when the connection returns.

faqs.question: Is KiLN for sale right now?
faqs.answer: Not yet. The pricing is published and the product is specified; the storefront opens when the first pilot hub is agreed.

faqs.question: Who owns the data?
faqs.answer: The hub. A Cloud deployment keeps one database per hub; a Node deployment keeps the database on the university's own hardware.

brand.name: KiLN
brand.usage: The mark is a kiln: a fired block with strata and an arch door. Use accent blue as the body and warm orange for the flame only; never recolour the flame.
brand.direction: Dark, editorial, product-led. The kiln supplies the metaphor and the only warm colour: flame orange is the CTA and the accent, blue is the mark and the data, mint means live. Light-surface use should invert canvas and ink and keep flame unchanged.
